Given a ~60km construction-status line typically commissions in 18-24 months and GEM's data is already ~11 months stale, this reads as at least 'stale', possibly 'change' -- recommend a dedicated follow-up once jxgajc.com or Wayback are reachable, since a completion-acceptance notice would be close to dispositive per the document ladder.
